app.title: CraftTab Options
background.seedDescription: This seed determines the current background pattern.
background.seedEditDescription: The seed determines the background pattern. Same seed always produces the same background.
background.aboutDescription: The background consists of connected triangles with pale colors from the project palette. Horizontal and vertical gradients are applied for a smooth visual effect.
background.aboutSeed: Each seed generates a unique pattern that will always look the same across different sessions.
